user_story: As a user, I want the forgot-password endpoint to require the email field so that incomplete requests are rejected.

positive.title: Submit valid forgot-password request with email
steps: Step 1: Send a POST request to the forgot-password endpoint with a valid email in the payload.
Step 2: Check the response for a success message indicating that the password reset email has been sent.
positive.expected_result: Response includes a success message and status code 200.

negative.title: Submit forgot-password request without email
steps: Step 1: Send a POST request to the forgot-password endpoint without an email in the payload.
Step 2: Check the response for an error message indicating that the email field is required.
negative.expected_result: Response includes an error message and status code 400.

edge.title: Submit forgot-password request with empty email field
steps: Step 1: Send a POST request to the forgot-password endpoint with an empty email field in the payload.
Step 2: Check the response for an error message indicating that the email field cannot be empty.
edge.expected_result: Response includes an error message and status code 400.
